title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B9.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: M1.1 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 18:27 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.7 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 07:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 714 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Sunny's watching that M-Class flare! Things are moving pretty quickly out there. 💥💨💣🌞

A prominent active region with bright coronal loops is visible near the center of the Sun today.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
